GeneLoop adapts selected layout geometry and color roles from Presenton General.
Source https://github.com/presenton/presenton
Commit bf5179fc712c4e5d225511f46960478f80879da7
Original file templates/general/template.json
Licensed under Apache License 2.0. See Presenton-LICENSE.txt.
Modifications include CJK fonts, readable type roles, parameterized user content,
and deterministic editable SVG composition through GeneLoop's shared delivery.
External font downloads, sample identities, stock imagery and application services
are outside this selected adaptation.
